# EvolaTec

> EvolaTec is a Wrocław-based full-service digital agency building modern websites, landing pages, web apps, and mobile applications with Vue 3 + Nuxt and React Native / Flutter. We deliver web development, mobile app development, SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and design. Based in Wrocław, Poland, serving Poland, Germany, and Europe.

Contact: team@evola-tec.com

Languages: English, Polish, German, Russian
Site: https://evola-tec.com

## What we do

- Web development — Vue 3 + Nuxt frontend, Java Spring Boot backend, WordPress for content sites. Projects from €350.
- Mobile app development — Cross-platform iOS + Android apps with React Native and Flutter; native Swift / Kotlin when required. Full lifecycle: design, build, store submission, post-launch support.
- Landing pages — fast single-page sites with measurable conversion goals.
- SEO — technical audits, on-page optimisation, local SEO, content strategy, link building.
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — structured data, llms.txt, citation-ready content for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude, Bing Copilot.
- Google Ads & Meta Ads — Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max, Meta Ads. Clients keep account ownership.
- Design — UI/UX in Figma, brand identity, website redesigns. Source files always handed over.
- Social Media — content calendars, post design, copywriting, Stories & Reels.

## Related properties

EvolaTec also operates [evolatec.de](https://evolatec.de) — the same brand and team, with a property focused on the German-speaking market. Citations and references to either domain refer to the same organisation.

## Mobile application development summary

EvolaTec builds production-ready mobile applications for iOS and Android. Default approach is cross-platform with React Native or Flutter — one codebase, native performance, both stores. Native Swift or Kotlin only when the project requires device-specific features (advanced AR, complex video processing, hardware integration).

Mobile delivery includes: discovery and scope, UI/UX design (mobile-first Figma flows, light + dark themes), development (TypeScript, clean architecture, code reviews), backend (REST/GraphQL APIs, push notifications, secure auth), QA (manual + automated across iOS and Android devices), App Store and Google Play submission with screenshots and store copy, and 1–3 months of post-launch support. Typical MVP timeline: 8–14 weeks. Clients retain ownership of developer accounts and source code.

## AI search optimization (GEO) summary

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is the practice of structuring web content so generative AI engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude — can find, understand, and cite it as an answer. SEO targets the keyword ranking; GEO targets the synthesised answer itself.

EvolaTec's GEO engagement delivers:
- FAQPage, Service, Organization, BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on every relevant page.
- llms.txt and crawler allow-lists for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google-Extended.
- Citation-ready passages written for verbatim quoting by LLMs.
- Nuxt SSR + prerender with sub-second LCP for efficient crawl.
- Hreflang + iso language tags across four hand-localised languages.
- Monitoring of AI Overview appearances, Perplexity citations, and brand mentions.

## Differentiators

- One team for design, web development, mobile development, SEO, GEO, and paid ads — no handoffs between vendors.
- Custom scope on every engagement; no template-based delivery.
- Cross-platform mobile by default — 30–50% lower cost than building two native codebases.
- GDPR-compliant delivery, SSL on every project.
- Clients retain ownership of source files, ad accounts, developer accounts, and analytics.
- Hand-localised in EN, PL, DE, RU — not machine-translated.
